facts: DID YOU KNOW? INDIANA HAS WON FIVE NATIONAL CHAMPIONSHIPS: 1940, 1953, 1976, 1981 AND 1987!
THE 1975-76 HOOSIERS WENT 32-0 - THE LAST UNDEFEATED NATIONAL CHAMPION IN MEN'S COLLEGE BASKETBALL!
INDIANA BEAT MICHIGAN 86-68 FOR THE 1976 NATIONAL TITLE - KENT BENSON WAS THE FINAL FOUR'S MOST OUTSTANDING PLAYER!
SCOTT MAY WAS THE NATIONAL PLAYER OF THE YEAR IN 1976!
THE 1974-75 HOOSIERS WENT 31-1, THEIR ONLY LOSS COMING TO KENTUCKY IN THE REGIONAL FINAL!
BOB KNIGHT COACHED INDIANA FROM 1971 TO 2000, WINNING 662 GAMES AND THREE NATIONAL TITLES!
BRANCH MCCRACKEN COACHED THE HURRYIN' HOOSIERS TO NATIONAL TITLES IN 1940 AND 1953!
ISIAH THOMAS LED INDIANA PAST NORTH CAROLINA 63-50 FOR THE 1981 NATIONAL TITLE!
ISIAH THOMAS WAS THE NO. 2 PICK IN THE 1981 NBA DRAFT BY THE DETROIT PISTONS!
REMEMBER WHEN? KEITH SMART'S BASELINE JUMPER BEAT SYRACUSE 74-73 FOR THE 1987 NATIONAL TITLE!
STEVE ALFORD WON OLYMPIC GOLD IN 1984 AND A NATIONAL TITLE WITH INDIANA IN 1987!
INDIANA HAS REACHED EIGHT FINAL FOURS: 1940, 1953, 1973, 1976, 1981, 1987, 1992 AND 2002!
THE 2002 HOOSIERS STUNNED NO. 1 DUKE 74-73 IN THE SWEET 16 ON THE WAY TO THE NATIONAL TITLE GAME!
CALBERT CHEANEY IS THE BIG TEN'S ALL-TIME LEADING SCORER WITH 2,613 POINTS!
CALBERT CHEANEY WAS THE NATIONAL PLAYER OF THE YEAR IN 1993!
ASSEMBLY HALL OPENED IN 1971 AND WAS RENAMED SIMON SKJODT ASSEMBLY HALL IN 2016!
FIVE NATIONAL CHAMPIONSHIP BANNERS HANG IN ASSEMBLY HALL!
THE HOOSIERS ARE FAMOUS FOR THEIR CANDY-STRIPED WARMUP PANTS!
THE WILLIAM TELL OVERTURE TIMEOUT AT ASSEMBLY HALL HAS BEEN CALLED THE GREATEST TIMEOUT IN COLLEGE BASKETBALL!
BELIEVE IT OR NOT: CHRISTIAN WATFORD'S BUZZER BEATER SANK NO. 1 KENTUCKY 73-72 IN DECEMBER 2011!
THE 2013 HOOSIERS WON THE BIG TEN OUTRIGHT AND EARNED A NO. 1 SEED!
VICTOR OLADIPO AND CODY ZELLER WENT NO. 2 AND NO. 4 IN THE 2013 NBA DRAFT!
WALT BELLAMY WON OLYMPIC GOLD IN 1960 AND WAS THE NO. 1 PICK IN THE 1961 NBA DRAFT!
KENT BENSON WAS THE NO. 1 PICK IN THE 1977 NBA DRAFT!
DON SCHLUNDT STARRED FOR THE 1953 NATIONAL CHAMPION HOOSIERS!
TRAYCE JACKSON-DAVIS WAS A CONSENSUS FIRST-TEAM ALL-AMERICAN IN 2023 AND IS INDIANA'S ALL-TIME LEADING REBOUNDER!
DARIAN DEVRIES BECAME INDIANA'S HEAD COACH IN 2025!
INDIANA BASKETBALL PLAYED ITS FIRST SEASON IN 1901!
HOO-HOO-HOO HOOSIERS! INDIANA WEARS CREAM AND CRIMSON!
